title: Art Center & Events Administrative Support Intern
description:
Primary Purpose of the Position

The Art Center & Events Administrative Support Intern provides administrative, scheduling, and operational support to the Events Coordinator & Development Associate Manager in the coordination and execution of events across Graded.

A primary responsibility is to support reservations and scheduling for Art Center spaces, including the Black Box Theatre, Haddad Center, Art Gallery, classrooms, and other designated areas. The Art Center & Events Administrative Support Intern also assists with event records, calendar updates, service requests, purchase orders, payment processes, event preparation, and on-site logistical support.


Principle Duties and Responsibilities

Art Center Reservations & Scheduling

  • Support reservations and scheduling for Art Center spaces.
  • Review requests, check availability, identify scheduling conflicts, and maintain accurate reservation records.
  • Enter and update approved reservations in EvM and relevant school calendars.
  • Communicate confirmations, changes, and space-use information to requesters.
  • Follow up on missing information and escalate conflicts or exceptions to the Events Coordinator & Development Associate Manager.

Event Management System & Calendar Support

  • Provide administrative and logistical support for school events.
  • Assist with event schedules, checklists, service requests, guest information, signage, and other operational materials.
  • Coordinate routine requests with Maintenance, ICT, Cafeteria, Security, and other departments as needed.
  • Maintain organized event records, files, spreadsheets, and supporting documentation.
  • Assist with the creation of purchase orders in the ERP system, payment requests, and process follow-up.
  • Support faculty and staff with routine questions related to reservations and event procedures.

Event Coordination & Administrative Support

  • Assist with event setup and breakdown and help ensure spaces are ready for scheduled use.
  • Support guest reception, registration, wayfinding, and other event-day activities as needed.
  • Monitor assigned event spaces and report operational, maintenance, safety, or facility concerns.
  • Help ensure spaces are properly reset following events.
  • Support evening and weekend events when required and permitted within the internship schedule.
  • Assist with the creation of purchase orders in the ERP system, as well as with payment requests and follow-up throughout the process.

Art Center Space Readiness

  • Conduct routine checks of Art Center spaces in connection with scheduled reservations and events.
  • Help ensure that reserved spaces are organized and ready for use.
  • Identify and report concerns related to cleanliness, furniture, audiovisual equipment, maintenance, safety, or general facility conditions.
  • Support the organization of event supplies, signage, materials, and other shared resources.
  • Report discrepancies between approved reservations and actual space usage to the Events Coordinator & Development Associate Manager.
  • Assist in maintaining organized records related to Art Center space utilization and recurring operational needs.

Professional Practice

  • Work under the direction of the Events Coordinator & Development Associate Manager and collaborate professionally with different school departments.
  • Maintain confidentiality and appropriate professional boundaries with students.
  • Comply with Graded’s Child Safeguarding Code of Conduct, policies, and procedures.
  • Demonstrate professionalism, reliability, organization, and a service-oriented approach.
  • Perform other internship-related duties as assigned by the Events Coordinator & Development Associate Manager.


Certifications and Education

Currently enrolled in an undergraduate degree program eligible for a formal internship.


Experience

  • Previous internship, volunteer, university, or extracurricular experience involving events, administration, customer service, scheduling, or project support.
  • Familiarity with calendars, spreadsheets, reservation systems, or event management tools.

title: Expansão da O2 Capital | Assessores de Investimentos
description:

title: Analista de Performance & Funil
description:
Empresa de tecnologia B2B contrata Analista de Performance & Funil para transformar a inteligência analítica de Revenue Operations em decisão e ritmo de gestão.

A posição é o elo entre os dados de receita e as lideranças comerciais. Não é uma vaga de construção de dashboard: o foco está em interpretar, apresentar, conduzir os fóruns de resultado e acompanhar as alavancas até o compromisso virar execução.


PRINCIPAIS RESPONSABILIDADES

Análise e gestão de dados de receita

  • Monitorar e reportar os principais KPIs de receita entre as unidades de negócio: conversão por etapa, novas receitas, NRR, receita basal, churn, CAC e ROI
  • Manter e evoluir a análise de cohort de receita como indicador longitudinal — expansão, contração e churn por coorte
  • Consolidar a visão de lag e lead indicators, identificando desvios antes que virem problema

Rituais e fóruns de gestão

  • Conduzir as reuniões semanais de resultado com líderes de Vendas, CS e Implantação
  • Levar não apenas números, mas diagnóstico, hipótese de causa e recomendação de ação
  • Preparar o deck semanal e os insumos analíticos que sustentam os rituais
  • Garantir que os compromissos definidos sejam registrados, acompanhados e cobrados

Planejamento comercial e forecast

  • Consolidar o forecast semanal e mensal: receita basal, churn projetado e novas receitas em pipeline
  • Consolidar e cascatear o orçamento anual para os times, acompanhando desvios e oportunidades
  • Apoiar a Gerência de Revenue Operations na modelagem de metas por time, canal ou produto
  • Identificar riscos e oportunidades no pipeline com antecedência suficiente para ação

Interface com Enablement

  • Participar do diagnóstico cruzado mensal, traduzindo dados de negócio em gaps de execução
  • Sinalizar quando uma queda de performance é comportamento, processo ou contexto externo
  • Apoiar os insumos dos planos de capacitação com base em resultado por área e por cargo

Parceria com as áreas

  • Acompanhar planos de ação, sinalizar desvios e garantir a execução dos compromissos
  • Cobrar SLA de preenchimento e qualidade de dado no CRM junto às lideranças

O QUE ESPERAMOS DO PERFIL

  • Autonomia alta: conduz rituais e apresentações sem supervisão direta
  • Confortável com análises de receita, cohort e cenários de forecast com múltiplas variáveis
  • Capacidade de sustentar conversa com liderança sênior a partir do dado
  • Contratação CLT | atuação 100% presencial

title: 3D Character Animator
description:
3D Character Animator - Indie Platform Fighter

I'm looking to hire an experienced 3D Character Animator to help bring the fighters in an upcoming indie platform fighter to life.

The game is a fast-paced, combat-focused platform fighter featuring gods, deities, and religious figures from different traditions battling one another. I'm looking for someone who can create dynamic, highly readable, hard-hitting combat animation , with attacks that feel powerful, responsive, expressive, and satisfying in gameplay.

What I'm Looking For

Required

  • Strong professional portfolio demonstrating 3D character animation
  • Ideally 5–10+ years of 3D animation experience
  • Experience working on indie games or other real-time game projects
  • Excellent understanding of:
  • Combat animation
  • Body mechanics
  • Weight and momentum
  • Timing, anticipation, follow-through, and impact
  • Exaggerated poses and readable silhouettes
  • Ability to create everything from quick jabs and movement animations to large, epic special attacks and finishing moves
  • Understanding of the technical constraints of animation for real-time gameplay
  • Comfortable iterating based on how animations actually feel in-game

Strongly Preferred

  • Cascadeur
  • Blender
  • Unity
  • Experience exporting animation assets and implementing/testing them inside Unity
Bonus Skills

I'd especially love to find someone capable of handling more of the full 3D character pipeline , including:

  • Retopology (for minor clean-up work)
  • UV unwrapping
  • Texturing
  • Rigging (especially for animals, or characters with multiple arms or wings)
  • Weight painting
  • Character and animal animation
  • Preparing/exporting characters and animations for Unity
  • Troubleshooting rigs, meshes, animation clips, and import settings

These additional skills are a major plus, but animation is the priority . If you're an exceptional combat animator who specializes specifically in animation, I still want to hear from you.

The Project

This is an indie platform fighter built around a roster of mythological and religious characters, with an intentionally comedic, irreverent, and satirical tone.

Important: The game contains deliberately blasphemous and sacrilegious humor and jokes about gods, religions, religious beliefs, and religious figures. Applicants need to be genuinely comfortable working on that kind of material.

Who Would Be a Great Fit

I'm looking for someone who:

  • Loves making combat animation feel ridiculously satisfying
  • Understands that gameplay readability matters as much as beautiful animation
  • Can exaggerate movement without making it feel weightless
  • Is comfortable working collaboratively and iterating quickly
  • Has experience with small or independent game-development teams
  • Can take a relatively simple stylized character and give them a huge amount of personality through movement
  • If you've worked on a fighting game, platform fighter, action game, or anything involving exaggerated character combat, I'd especially like to see it.

title: Global Sales Support Specialist (Contractor)
description:
Role Description

The Global Sales Support Specialist (GSS) is a critical driver of revenue within the Sales Finance organization, empowering the Field Sales Team with expert support in complex quoting, order processing, and product configuration. As a subject matter expert, the GSS ensures seamless deal execution while collaborating across functions to streamline processes and maximize efficiency.


This fast-paced role demands a proactive, highly organized individual who thrives under pressure. The GSS directly engages with internal sales and business operations teams to optimize sales execution, enable new product introductions, and keep quoting operations running smoothly and effectively.

  • Location - Sao Paulo - HYBRID/ 3 days in office or 70% in office throughout the month
  • Duration - 12 months


Your Impact

This position calls for someone who possesses good communication skills, sense of ownership, proactiveness and maturity working with confidential and sensitive information. This person is a self-starter, flexible, has a high level of integrity and quick to action in a fast-paced, team-oriented, collaborative environment.


Sales Support Excellence:

  • Support the Field Sales Team with quoting complex deals, responding to order inquiries, and providing guidance on product configurations in SFDC CPQ. Facilitate training on quote-to-order processes, including SFDC quoting sessions, ensuring that our Sales team members are equipped with the knowledge needed to drive sales success.

Cross-Functional Collaboration:

  • Work closely with teams including Deal Review, Pricing, Product, Sales Operations, and IT to ensure the smooth implementation of business policies, scalable quoting processes, and GTM offerings in SFDC CPQ.

Process Documentation & Best Practices:

  • Collaborate with the documentation team to ensure that our quoting decks are accurate, well-structured, and aligned to drive sales success. Act as a Subject Matter Expert in new product introductions, helping to design and refine quoting best practices for both new and existing products, ensuring clarity and consistency across all enablement materials.

System & Process Improvement:

  • Serve as a key partner in driving business requirements for system enhancements in SFDC CPQ, actively participating in the testing and UAT process to ensure new functionalities align with business needs. Identify and escalate system gaps or opportunities for process improvements, collaborating to streamline workflows and eliminate inefficiencies.

GTM Readiness & Operational Coordination:

  • Ensure the operational readiness of new GTM offers by collaborating with cross-functional teams to enable seamless execution of new product offerings. Build strong relationships with internal teams (Product, Sales, Legal, IT, etc.) to ensure alignment and smooth quoting processes.

Project Management & Communication:

  • Work with business partners to define objectives, set timelines, and track the status of quoting changes. Communicate milestones, dependencies, and project status updates to key stakeholders to ensure alignment and project success.

Prioritization & Execution:

  • Manage a shared mailbox for Global Sales Support activities, prioritizing requests based on revenue impact, customer relationship considerations, and timing requirements to meet deadlines.


Your Experience


Experience:

  • 5+ years of experience in Sales Support, Sales Operations, Finance, or Contract Management, preferably in a SaaS or subscription-based business. Proven experience with Pricing/Quoting processes and an understanding of GTM strategies.

Technical Proficiency:

  • Strong experience with Salesforce (SFDC CPQ) and proficiency with Google Suite (Gmail, Sheets, Docs, etc.) is essential. A tech-savvy mindset and ability to navigate complex systems to enhance quoting processes.

Communication & Collaboration:

  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate effectively with customers, internal teams, and International stakeholders. Ability to balance individual tasks while supporting team priorities in a dynamic environment.

Organizational & Analytical Skills:

  • Extremely detail-oriented with a high level of organization and the ability to manage multiple competing priorities simultaneously. Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to analyze processes and suggest improvements.

Additional Requirements:

  • Ability to work extended hours as needed, particularly around month-end or quarter-end workloads. Flexibility to work alternate shifts to accommodate global requests and ensure timely support.
  • Language: Fluent English, Spanish and Portuguese.


Information about Palo Alto Networks

At Palo Alto Networks®, everything starts and ends with our mission:

Being the cybersecurity partner of choice, protecting our digital way of life.

We have the vision of a world where each day is safer and more secure than the one before. These aren’t easy goals to accomplish — but we’re not here for easy. We’re here for better. We are a company built on the foundation of challenging and disrupting the way things are done, and we’re looking for innovators who are as committed to shaping the future of cybersecurity as we are.

title: Analista FP&A júnior
description:
A falta de tempo sempre foi considerada inimiga da alimentação saudável. Quem nunca precisou recorrer a “fast-food pesadão” por dispor de apenas alguns minutos para almoçar?


Para nós 10 minutos é tempo de sobra para você preparar ou receber refeições deliciosas e saudáveis!

Após duas décadas no ramo de alimentação, hoje atuamos com a Cumbuca Boa e a Piadina Romagnola.


A Cumbuca Boa é um e-commerce que oferece comida ultracongelada, saudável e deliciosa. Que nasceu para democratizar o acesso a uma alimentação de qualidade e quebrar de vez o tabu da comida congelada, acredite se quiser… Ou melhor, experimente e dê sua opinião!

A empresa tem como propósito revitalizar a imagem da comida instantânea, proporcionando refeições ultra-rápidas e com a qualidade de comida feita em casa. Nosso crescimento e os constantes elogios comprovam que nossos clientes estão de acordo.


A Piadina Romagnola é o resultado de um sonho antigo de construir uma empresa no ramo da alimentação. Nela oferecemos um sanduíche delicioso e tradicional, a Piadina, muito mais saudável e equilibrado que as opções mais comuns. Fundada em 2012 com a primeira unidade no Morumbi Shopping, atua hoje em 15 unidades localizadas em alguns do melhores pontos da cidade de São Paulo, atendendo cerca de 80.000 clientes/mês.

Tanto na Cumbuca quanto na Piadina nossa missão é uma só: encantar nossos clientes todos os dias através de uma alimentação deliciosa, saudável e prática.

Nossos principais ingredientes são amor e carinho.


Gostamos de proporcionar o bem aos outros, seja através da nossa comida, seja através da nossa forma de trabalhar.


Na nossa Cumbuca, cabe qualidade

Procuramos fazer as coisas bem feitas

Na nossa Cumbuca, cabe proatividade

Gostamos de gente que faz

Na nossa Cumbuca, cabe criatividade

Novas idéias são sempre bem-vindas.

Na nossa Cumbuca, cabe cooperação

Cultivamos um ambiente onde todos constroem juntos.

Na nossa Cumbuca, cabe ambição

Não temos limite pra crescer

Na nossa Cumbuca, cabem todos os sonhos do mundo

Se você sonha com um mundo mais saudável, vem sonhar com a gente!


Descrição da Vaga


Encontrar uma empresa jovem, com um ambiente aberto, dinâmico e sempre orientado à satisfação de nossos clientes. Estamos em uma fase de crescimento acelerado nas duas empresas, o que prova que estamos no caminho certo! Fazer parte dessa fase significa vivenciar algo único: uma empresa que hoje é pequena, mas que amanhã pode ter o tamanho dos sonhos das pessoas que dela fazem parte.


Para sonhar com o nosso apetite de crescimento, precisamos de uma pessoa que tenha experiência ou deseje aprender sobre área de Operações. Alguém que tenha conhecimento, pró atividade e discernimento para, com o passar do tempo, prever e antecipar demandas e próximos passos.


Objetivo


Atuar no planejamento e análise financeira da companhia, fornecendo informações confiáveis, análises críticas e indicadores que suportem a tomada de decisão da diretoria. O Analista de FP&A será responsável por acompanhar o desempenho financeiro e operacional do negócio, identificar desvios, propor melhorias e contribuir para o aumento da rentabilidade, eficiência e previsibilidade dos resultados.


Nessa posição


Buscamos um(a) Analista de FP&A para atuar diretamente no planejamento financeiro, análise de resultados e suporte à tomada de decisão da companhia. Procuramos alguém com forte capacidade analítica, perfil proativo e que goste de estruturar processos e transformar dados em informações úteis para o negócio.


  • Elaborar e acompanhar Orçamento, Comitê Financeiro, Relatório trimestral.
  • Desenvolver e atualizar modelos financeiros.
  • Analisar DRE, balanço patrimonial e fluxo de caixa.
  • Elaborar apresentações executivas para diretoria e sócios.
  • Construir e acompanhar indicadores financeiros e operacionais (KPIs).
  • Realizar análises de rentabilidade por produto, canal, loja e unidade de negócio.
  • Apoiar projetos de redução de custos e aumento de eficiência.
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com Contabilidade, Compras, Operações para garantir a qualidade das informações financeiras.
  • Participar da melhoria contínua dos processos financeiros e da implantação de sistemas PROTHEUS.


Requisitos Técnicos:


  • Formação em Administração de Empresas, Contabilidade, Economia ou Engenharia.
  • Experiência em FP&A, Controladoria, Consultoria ou áreas financeiras.
  • Bons conhecimentos de Excel e Power Point
  • Capacidade analítica e raciocínio lógico;
  • Habilidade para aprender, pensar e trabalhar rápido
  • Boa comunicação
  • Atenção a detalhes e organização ímpar


Como se trata de uma empresa jovem, pensamos numa posição majoritariamente presencial. Estamos localizados no Bairro Vila Cordeiro, São Paulo, 10 minutos da estação de metro Brooklin.

title: National Sales Director (Brazil)
description:
Job Title: National Sales Director - Brazil

Reports To: Head of Overseas Business Unit

Location: Brazil (Remote, frequent travel required)


Position Overview

To support the company's strategic development, we are investing significantly in the Brazilian market to accelerate brand growth, product localization, and sales network expansion. We are seeking a National Sales Director for Brazil who will be responsible for the overall market strategy, sales planning, channel development, and team leadership. The goal is to rapidly achieve broad product coverage across Brazil and develop tailored product and sales strategies for the local market.

The ideal candidate will have established nationwide distributor and customer relationships, enabling them to contribute immediately. Preference will be given to candidates with prior experience at leading baking ingredient manufacturers in a similar role.


Key Responsibilities

A. Market Strategy & Planning

  1. Develop and execute the overall sales strategy, channel plan, and annual business objectives for Brazil.
  2. Lead product localization initiatives to meet Brazilian market needs and drive product adaptation.
  3. Rapidly expand the national sales network to ensure broad market coverage.

B. Channel Development & Management

  1. Identify, negotiate with, and onboard national distributors and key strategic partners.
  2. Manage relationships with distributors and major customers, optimizing processes and service delivery.
  3. Maintain distributor and customer profiles, conduct regular performance reviews, and implement improvement plans.

C. Brand & Marketing Promotion

  1. Develop and implement brand-building activities, including marketing campaigns, PR events, and digital outreach.
  2. Organize product demonstrations, technical trainings, and industry exhibitions to increase brand visibility.

D. Cross-functional Collaboration

  1. Work closely with product, R&D, and marketing teams to share market insights and support product development.
  2. Provide training and support to distributors and customers on products, applications, and sales techniques.

E. Market & Competitive Intelligence

  1. Monitor competitor activities, market trends, and regulatory changes to adjust strategies proactively.
  2. Prepare regular market reports and business forecasts for headquarters.


Qualifications

A. Experience

  1. Minimum 15 years of sales management experience in the baking ingredients industry, with a focus on non-dairy whipping toppings or related products, specifically in the Brazilian market.
  2. Previous experience in a similar role at companies is highly preferred.
  3. Established network of national distributors and key clients, with the ability to execute quickly.

B. Knowledge

  1. Full understanding of bakery products and familiarity with bakery operations or production processes.
  2. Proficient in Microsoft Office for data analysis, reporting, and presentation.

C. Competency

  1. Strong strategic thinking, negotiation skills, and business acumen.
  2. Resilient under pressure and willing to travel frequently.
  3. Excellent collaboration and stakeholder management skills.


We Offer

  1. Competitive compensation package.
  2. Opportunity to lead in a high-priority strategic market with significant growth potential.
  3. Full support from global headquarters in product, marketing, and technical resources.



About Hi-Road Food Technology

Shanghai Hi-road Food Technology Co., Ltd. is a leading integrated enterprise specializing in the research, development, production, and distribution of premium bakery and catering ingredients. Committed to becoming the preferred partner in the global baking industry, we dedicate ourselves to providing customers with innovative, safe, and delicious food solutions.

With our strong independent R&D capabilities, Hi-Road meticulously sources world-class raw materials and employs advanced production technologies. Our comprehensive quality control system ensures the consistent excellence of our diverse product portfolio, which includes:

•Dairy and non-dairy toppings

•Premium fruit preparations

•Chocolate products

•Bakery creams and margarine compounds

•Flavor sauces

•Food flavors and additives

Through continuous innovation and stringent quality standards, we strive to deliver exceptional value and culinary inspiration to our partners worldwide

Você vai liderar, no dia a dia, o Assessment de RGM para uma empresa no setor de bens de consumo. Trabalhará com C-Level e Diretoria do cliente para diagnosticar maturidade, dimensionar o Size of the Prize e desenhar o roadmap em ondas. Também vai trabalhará nas bases de dados, na pesquisa de maturidade e nos entregáveis executivos que vão sustentar o roadmap do cliente, com mentoria direta de Senior Manager e Consultant.


O que você vai fazer

  • Coordenar as 4 frentes do Assessment: Pesquisa on-line, Análise de Dados, Entrevistas e Workshop
  • Liderar análises por pilar de RGM: Preço, Promoção, Termos Comerciais, Sortimento e PPA
  • Conduzir entrevistas com lideranças C-Level e áreas correlatas (Comercial, Trade, Marketing)
  • Construir heatmap de maturidade (5 Pilares × 7 Dimensões) e Mapa de Dores
  • Co-facilitar o Workshop executivo de priorização (Valor × Complexidade) e estruturar o roadmap em ondas
  • Mentorar o Sr. Associate do time core
  • Operacionalizar o data request e construir a base unificada de análise
  • Executar análises quantitativas dos pilares de RGM: cascata de preço, ROI promocional, aderência ao JBP, mix por canal/cliente
  • Configurar e operar a pesquisa on-line de maturidade
  • Construir dashboards de apoio em Power BI/Excel
  • Apoiar agendamento, notas de entrevistas e preparação do Workshop
  • Produzir slides executivos sob orientação do Consultant


O que procuramos

  • Experiência áreas internas de RGM/Pricing no setor industrial / bens de consumo.
  • Domínio comprovado em ao menos 2 pilares de RGM (Preço, Promoção, JBP, Sortimento/PPA)
  • Excel avançado (modelagem, what-if, elasticidade)
  • Postura executiva: confortável com Diretoria e C-Level
  • Inglês avançado
  • Capacidade de lidar com grandes volumes de dados transacionais
  • PowerPoint executivo: transformar análise em slide claro


Contratação: PJ + benefícios (plano médico, odontológico, alimentação, seguro de vida, bem - estar)

Modelo Híbrido: São Paulo - Capital.

title: Fonoaudiólogo
description:
Detalhes da vaga

Quais são os desafios da área e do cargo:

Esta pessoa terá como objetivo atuar de forma alinhada à visão estratégica de Negócios do Grupo Fleury, contribuindo para a construção de um ecossistema de Saúde integrado, preventivo e híbrido, tendo como principal foco o cuidado com as pessoas.

Se você tem interesse em fazer parte desse propósito e deseja estar sempre um passo a frente do mercado, vem com a gente!

Principais Atividades

  • Executar os exames básicos de avaliação da audição, audiometria, audiometria infantil, audiometria de altas freqüências, imitanciometria e acufenometria;

Buscamos Alguém Que Apresente

Antes da inscrição na vaga, é importante verificar se você atende aos requisitos e se conecta com nosso propósito.

  • Curso superior completo em Fonoaudiologia;
  • Experiência comprovada em Audiologia Clinica;
  • Desejável especialização em Audiologia Clinica;

Nossa essência inspira o dia a dia, por isso, buscamos pessoas apaixonadas pelo que fazem, e que:

  • Estimulem um ambiente de troca de conhecimentos, compartilhando experiências, possibilitando a interdependência entre os times;
  • Estejam em constante movimento, investindo em autodesenvolvimento e atuando como facilitadora no desenvolvimento das outras pessoas;
  • Busquem consciência social de diversidade e inclusão, cooperando com a construção de um ambiente colaborativo;
  • Identifiquem e antecipem as necessidades dos clientes, agindo prontamente para encontrar soluções adequadas e personalizadas;
  • Planejem e executem o trabalho com excelência a fim de atingir os resultados esperados, com a visão de inovação e agilidade;
  • Gerem e implementem novas ideias, buscando constantemente por melhorias para a experimentação de novas abordagens e a adaptação às mudanças do mercado.

Informações Da Vaga

Modelo de Trabalho: 100% Presencial (Fleury Itaim ou Fleury Braz Leme)

Carga Horária: 180h

Escala: 6x1

Horário de Trabalho: das 06h45 às 13h, de segunda-feira a sábado (folgas fixas aos domingos)

Cuidamos de você em cada etapa da sua jornada!

Saúde e Bem-estar

  • Assistência médica e odontológica para você e sua família;
  • Ambulatório com clínica médica ou atendimento por telemedicina;
  • Linhas de cuidado especializadas: gestantes, adoção, obesidade, oncologia, entre outras;
  • Acesso à plataforma OrienteMe para sessões de terapia e orientação nutricional;
  • Licença maternidade e paternidade estendidas;
  • Acesso ao Wellhub para práticas esportivas e qualidade de vida.

Proteção e Estabilidade

  • Previdência privada;
  • Participação nos lucros;
  • Seguro de vida.

Facilidades Para o Dia a Dia

  • Vale-Alimentação;
  • Vale-Refeição;
  • Vale-Transporte;
  • Auxílio-Creche;
  • Clube de Descontos com lojas, farmácias, viagem, beleza, cultura, lazer, entre outros serviços.

Desenvolvimento e Educação

  • Plataforma de ensino;
  • Parcerias educacionais com descontos em cursos e instituições.

Aqui, o cuidado vai além dos benefícios — ele está presente em cada momento da sua trajetória.

Promovemos uma cultura inclusiva, focada na equidade e na valorização das diferenças. Nossas vagas são abertas para todos os públicos e, simbolizando a nossa intencionalidade, oferecemos oportunidades afirmativas.

Nosso compromisso vai além do cumprimento das legislações que incentivam a diversidade e inclusão. Trabalhamos ativamente para ampliar a representatividade de nossas pessoas, pensando em raça, etnia, gênero, gerações, pessoas com deficiência e LGBTQIAPN+ em nosso time, além de fortalecer a representatividade de mulheres negras, indígenas, chefes de família.

Para conhecer mais sobre o Grupo Fleury, acesse o site:

title: Collections Operations Lead – Brazil (LATAM Expansion)
description:
Ant International is a global leader in digital payments and financial technology, dedicated to connecting the world through inclusive and innovative solutions. As we expand our Buy Now, Pay Later (BNPL) footprint in Brazil, we are looking for an entrepreneurial Collections Operations Lead to build, scale, and optimize our local operations—with a roadmap to extend coverage across Latin America (including Mexico).


The Role

This is a high-impact, founding role within our Brazil collections team. You won't just manage existing processes—you will build them from the ground up. You will drive end-to-end execution across strategy deployment, BPO management, regulatory compliance, and cutting-edge AI tool integration.


Key Responsibilities

  • Strategy & Operations: Design and execute the full-cycle collections strategy for BNPL in Brazil, from early-stage reminders to late-stage recovery.
  • AI & Tech Innovation: Lead the evaluation, testing, and deployment of AI-driven collection solutions (conversational AI, smart dialers) and multi-channel communications (WhatsApp, Voice, SMS, RCS).
  • Regulatory Compliance: Ensure all operations strictly align with local laws and regulations (LGPD, BACEN, Consumer Protection Code).
  • Data Analytics & Performance: Track core KPIs (Contact, PTP, Cure, Roll, and Recovery rates), build customer segmentation models, and continuously optimize treatment strategies.
  • BPO & Partner Management: Select, onboard, and manage local BPO vendors, ensuring high performance standards and operational alignment.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with Credit Risk to feed post-loan insights back into underwriting models.
  • Regional Expansion: Scale operational frameworks to support future collections setup in Mexico and other LATAM markets.


What We Are Looking For


Must-Have:

  • Fintech/Scale-up Experience: Proven track record in collections operations within leading Fintechs or high-growth consumer credit platforms in LATAM (e.g., 99, Shopee, Nubank, Mercado Pago).
  • Deep Local Market Expertise: Comprehensive knowledge of Brazil’s collections landscape, BPO ecosystem, consumer behavior, and financial regulations (LGPD, BACEN).
  • End-to-End Ownership: Hands-on experience spanning strategy design, tool implementation, analytics, and vendor management.
  • Fluent English: Strong written and verbal communication skills to collaborate effectively with global teams.
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Business Analytics, or related fields.


Nice-to-Have:

  • Spanish proficiency to support expansion into Spanish-speaking LATAM markets.
  • Direct experience implementing AI voice/chatbots or intelligent dialers.
  • Experience working in multinational or cross-border Fintech environments.
  • Practical SQL or data analysis skills.


Ready to build the future of digital payments in LATAM? Apply now or reach out directly!

title: Accounting Lead
description:
Position Purpose


To lead and oversee the Accounting, Fiscal (Tax), Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, and Treasury functions. The incumbent is responsible for ensuring accuracy, compliance, and operational and reporting excellence across all financial processes. This leader must act as a strategic business consultant, ensuring strategic alignment and supporting decision-making across the entire company.

The owner of the role is also responsible for the fulfillment of both the Grünenthal and local Codes of Conduct in the activities organized by him/her, as well as in those in which he/she participates.


Key Responsibilities

Fiscal, Tax Governance, and Credits

  • Lead the tax credit strategy, actively seeking efficient and additional tax optimization opportunities, in full compliance and alignment with corporate governance.
  • Lead the entire implementation and update of the Brazilian Tax Reform, analyzing its impacts and ensuring business continuity and compliance.
  • Manage the relationship and deliverables of external consultants (Tax).
  • Lead compliance processes with external audit firms (Big Four).
  • Ensure full operational excellence and compliance in all legal and tax processes, aligned with policies, laws, and internal procedures.
  • Search for efficient tax strategies, according to corporate guidance.

Accounting, Audit, and Treasury Management

  • Oversee all Accounting (IFRS/CPCs/German GAAP), Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, and Treasury routines.
  • Lead and coordinate all external (Big Four) and internal audit processes, ensuring deadlines are met and recommendations are correctly implemented.
  • Ensure the accuracy and correct recording of all financial transactions.
  • Lead initiatives to optimize working capital.
  • Lead Continuous Process Improvement initiatives.
  • Manage the Service Level Agreements (SLAs) and execution of activities performed by the Shared Service Center (SSC) in Lisbon, Portugal.
  • Coordinate accounting, tax, and treasury projects and ensure their implementation according to corporate requirements.
  • Identify and establish effective procedures to safeguard company assets and ensure proper reporting to governmental entities in accordance with local legislation.
  • Manage the Other Operating Results Budget.
  • Prepare and monitor Cash Flow.
  • Ensure operational excellence and compliance in all legal and tax processes, aligned with policies, laws, and internal procedures.

Capability Requirements

Mandatory

  • University Degree in Accounting.
  • Active CRC (CPA equivalent).
  • Solid experience in Accounting and Tax Management.
  • Experience working with a Shared Service Center (SSC).
  • Experience reviewing Financial Statements.
  • Experience reviewing ECD and ECF filings.

Desirable

  • MBA or Postgraduate Degree in Finance or Controlling.
  • Previous experience with auditing firms (Big Four).

Interfaces

Internal

  • All business areas, with particular interaction with:
  • Sales
  • Marketing
  • Supply Chain
  • Legal
  • Finance Teams

External

  • Big Four Auditors
  • Tax and Accounting Consultants
  • Banks
  • Tax Authorities (RFB and others)
  • Fiscal and Accounting BPO Providers

title: Director of Procurement
description:
About Envision

Envision is a global green technology group committed to accelerating the energy transition through integrated renewable, storage, digital and hydrogen solutions.

Envision provides renewable energy system solutions to corporations, governments, and institutions worldwide, reducing the cost of renewable energy production, storage, and integration through continuous technological innovation. The company’s business spans smart wind turbines, energy storage, and green hydrogen solutions.

Today, Envision operates as an integrated net-zero technology ecosystem, combining hardware, software, and system integration capabilities across the full energy value chain.

The Group maintains a strong international presence with:

20+ R&D and operations centers

50+ manufacturing bases

80+ GW of installed wind capacity globally

10+ GWh of delivered storage capacity

Expanding green hydrogen industrial platforms

Over 50% of the international workforce

Key Platforms

Smart Wind Turbines

Envision’s smart wind platform integrates advanced sensing, digital models and digital twin technologies via the Galileo SuperSense System. With 80+ GW installed globally, Envision ranks first globally in orders and second in new installations since 2022, maintaining a leading international market position.

Energy Storage

The energy storage platform provides full-stack capabilities across battery cells, BMS, PCS, EMS and SCADA, delivering integrated end-to-end solutions. The business ranks third in China and fourth globally, with 200+ projects and 15+ GWh in orders. The ecosystem includes Envision AESC (global battery leader) and Univers (AIoT-enabled digital energy management platform).

Green Hydrogen

Envision is developing large-scale integrated green hydrogen and ammonia industrial parks, including one of the world’s largest net-zero hydrogen projects in Chifeng, Inner Mongolia (1.5 million tons planned annual capacity).


Key Responsibilities

1. Fully responsible for the company's procurement in the Latin American region, and for developing and optimizing regional procurement strategies.

2. Lead market research in Latin America, analyze regional industry trends, supplier capabilities, and market risks to support the company's procurement strategy and project decision-making.

3. Manage and deeply maintain the regional supplier ecosystem, regularly evaluate the quality of suppliers' products and services, and drive improvements in key supply chain systems.

4. Guide and participate in the negotiation, review, and management of procurement contracts to ensure they are legal and compliant, protecting the company's interests.

5. Develop and implement procurement cost control plans, continuously drive improvements in procurement processes, efficiency, and cost optimization to enhance project profitability.

6. Build and improve regional procurement processes, policies, and systems, promoting standardized procurement and digital advancement to achieve compliant and transparent processes.

7. Collaborate with delivery, operations, and other relevant departments, as well as headquarters resources, to effectively support the smooth execution of regional projects.


Job Requirements

  • 1. Bachelor's degree or above, preferably in a science or engineering major.
  • 2. Over 10 years of experience in procurement or supply chain management, with required experience in procurement in Latin America.
  • 3. Thorough understanding of procurement processes and cross-cultural supplier management, capable of independently leading procurement negotiations and maintaining supplier relationships.
  • 4. Strong cost awareness and data analysis abilities, with proven success in procurement cost control.
  • 5. Strong communication, collaboration, and conflict resolution skills, able to efficiently handle regional procurement emergencies.
  • 6. Highly responsible, self-motivated, big-picture thinker, able to handle pressure at key delivery milestones.
  • 7. Proficient in English, able to frequently travel across Latin American countries.
  • 8. Experience in building and managing procurement systems in the Latin American region for Fortune 500, international energy, or engineering companies is preferred.

title: Internal Auditor
description:
About VelaFi

At VelaFi, we're building the future of global financial infrastructure. As a stablecoin-powered platform, we help businesses move money across borders faster, more securely, and more efficiently by connecting local banking rails, global payment networks, and leading stablecoin ecosystems through regulated entities across Latin America, Asia, and the United States.

Our mission extends beyond payments—we are creating the infrastructure that enables businesses to operate confidently in an increasingly connected world. By combining innovative technology with regulatory excellence, we simplify complex global financial operations while maintaining the highest standards of compliance, security, and reliability.

Position Overview

VelaFi Brazil is seeking an independent Internal Auditor to establish and execute our internal audit framework required for Banco Central do Brasil (BCB) VASP/PSAV authorization under Resolution BCB No. 552/2025.

In this role, you will objectively evaluate the effectiveness of our governance, risk management processes, AML/CFT controls (Circular BCB No. 3,978/2020), cybersecurity measures, and cross-border payment operations.

Location

Hybrid: Sao Paulo, Brazil

Candidates must reside in Brazil and be legally authorized to work in the country. Periodic travel within Brazil and internationally may be required.

Key Responsibilities

  • Audit Plan & Execution: Design and execute an annual risk-based internal audit plan approved by the Board of Directors.
  • AML/CFT & Regulatory Testing: Conduct independent testing of AML/CFT controls (KYC/KYB, transaction monitoring, sanctions/PEP screening, SAR/ROS procedures).
  • Custody & Segregation Review: Evaluate asset segregation and digital asset custody controls in compliance with BCB regulations (e.g., Res. BCB 520).
  • Cybersecurity & Tech Audits: Assess IT controls, key management, Identity & Access Management (IAM), Business Continuity (BCP), and Disaster Recovery (DRP) frameworks (Res. BCB 552 / Res. BCB 85).
  • Reporting & Escalation: Report findings, control deficiencies, and remediation status directly to the Board. Support mock regulatory audits and pre-filing BCB readiness reviews.

Qualifications

  • Experience: Proven experience in internal/external audit or risk assurance within financial institutions, payment institutions (IP), or licensed VASPs/crypto entities in Brazil.
  • Regulatory Knowledge: Deep understanding of the BCB regulatory framework (Res. BCB 552, Circ. 3,978/2020).
  • Certifications: CIA (Certified Internal Auditor), CISA, CPA, or equivalent credentials preferred.
  • Languages: Professional fluency in English and Portuguese.

Desired Competencies

  • Financial Controls & Governance: Strong expertise in evaluating internal control frameworks, corporate governance, operational workflows, and segregation of customer assets.
  • Regulatory Reporting & Audit Expertise: Familiarity with BCB audit requirements and regulatory systems, including Unicad (IN BCB 712/713), COSIF accounting frameworks, and AML/CFT compliance.
  • Executive Presence & Independence: Ability to report directly and present objective findings to the Board of Directors and external regulators without operational bias.
  • Strong Analytical & Decision-Making Skills: Demonstrated skill in conducting root-cause analyses, dissecting complex transaction logs, and identifying systemic control gaps.
  • High Accountability & Ownership: Results-driven approach to tracking audit remediation plans and ensuring timely resolution of audit findings.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Ability to collaborate constructively with Compliance, Risk, Engineering, and Finance teams while maintaining strict audit independence.
  • Ability to build scalable audit infrastructure: Experience establishing risk-based internal audit methodologies, automated sampling procedures, and testing frameworks that scale from early-stage authorization to high-volume cross-border operations.

Nice to Have

  • Cross-Border & FX Audit Experience: Background auditing foreign exchange (Câmbio/eFX), international remittance rails, and multi-currency liquidity settlement.
  • Digital Assets & Crypto Auditing: Practical knowledge auditing blockchain transactions, digital asset custody (Res. BCB 520), and stablecoin flows (USDT/USDC).
  • Professional Certifications: Active CIA (Certified Internal Auditor), CISA (Certified Information Systems Auditor), CFA, or active CRC (Conselho Regional de Contabilidade).
  • RegTech & Automation Tools: Experience testing or auditing automated transaction monitoring, automated BACEN reporting software, and reconciliation engines.

Regulatory Requirements (Brazil VASP)

Candidates selected for this position must be eligible to satisfy applicable Brazilian regulatory requirements, including:

  • Be legally authorized to reside and work in Brazil.
  • Possess the qualifications, experience, and professional competence required to perform executive responsibilities.
  • Hold any professional registrations or licenses required under Brazilian law to perform the responsibilities of the position, where applicable.
  • Successfully complete background checks and regulatory due diligence.
  • Be eligible to serve as an executive of a regulated financial institution under applicable Brazilian laws.
  • Have no disqualifying criminal convictions, financial crimes, or regulatory restrictions that would prevent appointment.
  • Not have been declared bankrupt or legally insolvent.
  • Not have been suspended or prohibited from serving as an executive of regulated financial institutions.
  • Meet any additional "fit and proper" requirements established by the Central Bank of Brazil (BACEN) and other applicable regulatory authorities.

Equal Employment Opportunity

VelaFi is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to fostering a diverse, inclusive, and respectful workplace where everyone has the opportunity to thrive. We make employment decisions based on qualifications, merit, and business needs, and do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, creed, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, ancestry, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

title: Regional Manager, Tender Management and Pricing
description:
The Regional Manager, Tender Management and Pricing is responsible for leading both the pricing strategy and the tender management lifecycle across a defined geographic region. They oversee all aspects of pricing and bid management to drive competitive, margin‑conscious decisions across multimodal product lines. They partner closely with Sales, Operations, Procurement, and Carrier Management to develop aligned bid strategies and deliver winning tender responses. They build strong relationships with carriers, evaluate market conditions, and lead cross‑functional teams through complex RFQs, RFPs, and tender cycles. They develop regional pricing frameworks, establish best practices, and drive continuous improvement in pricing accuracy, tender quality, and commercial outcomes. They also provide strategic insights based on post‑tender evaluations, helping refine future pursuits and improve long‑term profitability.


Responsibilities

  • Oversee and manage the complete pricing and tender lifecycle, including analysis of wins/losses, pipeline performance, and regional pricing positions.
  • Develop and execute clear bid strategies in collaboration with sales, technical teams, and cross‑functional stakeholders, defining win themes, timelines, and resource needs.
  • Lead and motivate cross‑functional bid teams, assigning responsibilities, tracking deliverables, and ensuring timely, high‑quality tender submissions.
  • Conduct comprehensive reviews of RFPs, RFQs, and customer requirements to identify risks, operational considerations, and solution opportunities.
  • Manage regional relationships with air, ocean, and ground carriers, securing competitive rates and optimizing procurement strategies.
  • Develop regional pricing frameworks across multimodal services (ground, intermodal, air, ocean, contract logistics, etc.).
  • Ensure pricing outputs support profitable growth, align with target margins, and reinforce customer value propositions.
  • Partner with Operations to understand cost drivers, service capabilities, network constraints, and profitability levers.
  • Drive pricing strategy in alignment with Regional Sales leadership, ensuring consistency and commercial competitiveness.
  • Maintain visibility of regional pricing and tender pipeline performance, including turnaround time, quality metrics, and commercial outcomes.
  • Conduct post‑tender and post‑award reviews to identify lessons learned and implement continuous improvement best practices.
  • Stay informed on industry trends, competitor activity, market shifts, and procurement practices to guide strategic pricing decisions.
  • Provide training, coaching, and best‑practice guidance to regional sales and support teams on pricing tools and tender processes.
  • Support digital pricing initiatives, workflow standardization, and process optimization across regional teams.
  • All other duties as assigned to meet evolving business needs.


Qualifications

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field (e.g., Supply Chain, Administration, Foreign Trade, Project Management) from an accredited college or university required.
  • Certification/Licensure: Industry certifications such as CILT, CSCMP, APICS, FIATA, etc. preferred but not required.
  • Languages: English (Advanced) and Native Spanish (Advanced).
  • 3+ years of experience in pricing, tender management, and/or air/ocean freight forwarding.
  • Strong understanding of procurement processes, tender documentation, bid structures, and commercial/legal frameworks.
  • Excellent organizational, planning, and time management skills with the ability to manage multiple projects under tight deadlines.
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to convey complex information clearly and concisely.
  • Strong analytical and problem‑solving capabilities.
  • Demonstrated discretion and confidentiality in handling and protecting sensitive information.
  • Technical: Proficient with common office technologies, including Windows PCs, Microsoft O365 (Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, etc.) and web conferencing (Teams, Zoom, Webex, etc.).
  • Environment: Comfort commuting to/from and working in a 100% on‑site setting (listed in this posting), with travel for related meetings/events.

title: Key Account Sales Director
description:
JD Industrials | Director of Key Account Sales, Brazil

Work Location : Brazil (based in São Paulo, regular nationwide business travel)


Reporting to : Latin America Regional Lead


1. Business Overview

  • JD Industrials is the B2B industrial supply chain division of JD Group. We deliver one-stop digital procurement solutions covering MRO spare parts, industrial consumables, electrical automation, tools & security equipment, production materials and other industrial goods, and implement an accompanying global expansion strategy.


  • As Latin America’s largest industrial market, Brazil hosts numerous Chinese enterprises expanding overseas in new energy vehicles, construction machinery, infrastructure engineering, mining and manufacturing, alongside major local industrial conglomerates. JD Industrials has established a local legal entity in Brazil. Leveraging cross-border supply chains, local warehousing & distribution, customs clearance fulfillment and digital procurement platform capabilities, we serve Chinese-owned factories operating in Brazil and leading local industrial clients.


  • As the lead for key account sales in Brazil, this role takes charge of local KA client acquisition, commercial negotiations and long-term account management, builds the key account sales system, and drives sustained revenue growth of industrial goods business in Brazil.


2. Job Responsibilities

  • Key Account Development & Target Delivery

Take overall ownership of acquiring Chinese overseas enterprises and large local KA clients across manufacturing, infrastructure, energy and mining sectors in Brazil. Formulate key account sales strategies and annual business plans, deliver revenue, gross profit and collection targets assigned by headquarters, and secure long-term framework bulk procurement agreements. Independently engage client procurement directors, supply chain leaders and factory management teams; oversee the full lifecycle of business opportunities, tendering, commercial negotiations and contract signing.

  • In-depth Account Management & Demand Mining

Identify procurement pain points at client factories. Combine JD Industrials’ supply chain strengths to deliver customized solutions including MRO consolidated procurement, hybrid cross-border & local fulfillment, and digital procurement services. Continuously increase wallet share among existing clients, tap incremental opportunities across multiple production sites and subsidiaries, and foster long-term strategic partnerships.

  • Local Market & Competition Analysis

Continuously research Brazil’s industrial goods market regulations, major competitors, pricing frameworks of local suppliers, industry policies and import customs requirements. Produce periodic market analysis reports, feed client demands and category opportunities back to the regional headquarters, and support optimization of localized product assortments and fulfillment solutions for Brazil.

  • Cross-functional Collaboration & Project Execution

Coordinate with local Brazil teams covering operations, supply chain, customs and finance, as well as procurement & sales teams at China headquarters. Manage end-to-end order fulfillment, delivery tracking, invoicing & payment collection, and after-sales issue resolution. Control client receivables risks to maintain healthy cash flow.

Sales Team Building & Management (0-to-1 Local Team Establishment)

Build a local Brazilian key account sales talent pipeline aligned with business progress. Set individual KPIs and performance appraisal mechanisms. Equip the team with capabilities for business development and solution-based industrial sales, and coordinate joint efforts to deliver priority projects.

  • Ecosystem Partner Development

Engage local industry associations, channel partners and logistics service providers appropriately to expand lead sources and cultivate a sound local business ecosystem.


3. Job Requirements

  • Education & Language

Bachelor’s degree or above; fluent Portuguese (mandatory for commercial negotiations); English as working auxiliary language. Proficiency in Chinese is preferred (significant advantage for engaging Chinese enterprises).

Industry Experience (Mandatory)

Minimum 8 years of B2B industrial goods key account sales or sales management experience, with deep expertise in MRO, industrial spare parts, electrical equipment, tools, security products, automation and engineering materials. Familiar with industrial bulk procurement models and factory procurement decision-making chains.

Hands-on experience operating in the Brazilian market and existing client resources in manufacturing, new energy, infrastructure and mining sectors are preferred. Prior experience serving Chinese enterprises expanding overseas is a plus.

  • Core Competencies

Proven track record of 0-to-1 overseas market development. Expertise in annual bulk procurement negotiations and framework agreement management for large conglomerates. Basic understanding of cross-border industrial trade, import customs clearance and localized fulfillment. Result-oriented mindset with strong awareness of receivables risk control.

Capable of independently managing client projects with annual transaction volumes ranging from millions to tens of millions. Adept at solution-based sales instead of pure product trading.

  • Work Location Adaptability

Long-term assignment in Brazil; able to undertake frequent inter-city business travel within Brazil. Familiar with Brazilian business culture, labor laws and trade regulations. Comfortable with cross-time-zone collaboration with China headquarters.

Preferred Qualifications


  • Working experience with Schneider Electric, 3M, Grainger, RS Components, MISUMI, major local industrial distributors or cross-border industrial supply chain companies;


  • Understanding of industrial e-commerce and digital procurement platform business models;


  • Established senior-level connections with Chinese-owned factories or local industrial conglomerates in Brazil.

title: Keeta-业务目标分析管理专家（base 巴西）
description:
1. 业务目标/绩效体系搭建 承接组织目标和业务节奏，负责业务团队目标体系的系统性设计与拆解，涵盖中长期业务规划、季度/月度目标设定、业务达成路径拆解及资源匹配；确保组织目标的一致性与可承接性，同时主导绩效体系的设计和运营，确保业务团队绩效方案的及时和准确性，支持业务团队拿到结果。 2. 市场与业务动态跟踪分析 系统跟踪市场动态、竞争格局与业务节奏，持续评估目标合理性，及时主动调整目标以匹配业务阶段与策略变化；建立健全、整合的目标追踪机制，输出有数据支撑的经营分析报告（MBR/WBR/DBR），支持管理层决策。探索将AI/机器学习工具应用于业务异动预警与趋势预测，提升分析的前瞻性与时效性。 3. 专项经营分析与决策支持 针对重点业务问题开展深度专项研究，综合运用数据分析、用户洞察、市场研究等手段，输出有落地价值的策略建议；能够独立承接从问题定义、框架设计到结论呈现的全链路分析工作，为管理层提供高质量的经营洞察。

岗位要求:

1.本科及以上学历，数学、统计学、商业分析或商科相关专业； 2.5年及以上商业分析/目标管理/经营分析相关经验；有头部互联网或咨询公司背景者优先；有外卖/本地生活/电商平台经历者优先； 3.具备优秀的结构化思维能力，能够对复杂业务问题进行独立拆解与量化建模； 4.熟练使用SQL进行数据提取与分析，掌握至少一种数据可视化/分析工具；具备扎实的数理统计基本功； 5.对AI工具在商业分析/目标管理场景的应用有实战经验或浓厚兴趣，了解LLM辅助分析、AI预测模型等在经营管理中的落地逻辑；在使用AI工具过程中，严格遵守公司及所在国家/地区的数据安全与合规要求，确保业务数据、用户数据不被违规输入外部AI系统，具备数据安全意识与合规操作习惯； 6.具备优秀的跨部门沟通与协作能力，能够高效推动多方资源对齐，将分析结论转化为可执行的业务动作。

岗位亮点:

1.战略核心角色：直接参与业务目标体系的顶层设计，工作成果影响整个业务团队的经营节奏与方向； 2.全链路经营管理视野：从市场洞察到目标拆解再到落地追踪，快速积累系统化的经营管理方法论； 3.AI × 经营分析前沿实践：公司正系统推进AI在业务分析中的落地，BA岗是最核心的实验场，你将有机会主导智能化经营分析工具的探索与应用； 4.国际化多元团队：在快速成长的出海业务中工作，积累稀缺的跨文化经营管理经验； 5.高速成长通道：广阔的新兴市场空间+扁平决策链条，优秀者成长路径清晰且快速。

title: Business Analyst
description:
Business Analyst


We are looking for a Business Analyst to join a development team supporting one of our global clients in the United States. This role requires strong analytical and communication skills, with the ability to work effectively in distributed and multicultural environments.

The ideal candidate will act as the bridge between business stakeholders and technical teams, ensuring that business needs are accurately captured, documented, and translated into functional requirements that support successful project delivery.

Key Responsibilities

  • Gather, analyze, and document business requirements and effectively transfer knowledge to development teams.
  • Evaluate information collected through task analysis, business process reviews, surveys, interviews, and workshops.
  • Understand, analyze, and document functional and non-functional requirements.
  • Combine business knowledge with system understanding to create functional designs across applications.
  • Collaborate with development teams and provide guidance to ensure solutions meet business objectives.
  • Prepare detailed requirement specifications, functional specifications, user stories, and user interface documentation.
  • Communicate effectively with clients, stakeholders, and internal teams regarding functional requirements, interfaces, workflows, and application designs.
  • Document analysis findings, business workflows, and secure stakeholder approval and sign-off.
  • Design and execute test scenarios and test scripts.
  • Coordinate with business users during testing, validation, and evaluation of applications and software enhancements.
  • Manage requirement changes and support project plans to ensure delivery within agreed timelines.
  • Create Use Cases, Context Diagrams, and Activity Diagrams using appropriate modeling tools.
  • Develop User Requirement Specifications (URS) and Software Requirement Specifications (SRS).
  • Coordinate requirements gathering activities among multiple stakeholders, including onsite, offshore, and nearshore teams.
  • Support planning, implementation, configuration, and continuous improvement of business systems and applications.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's Degree completed in Technology or a related field.
  • Advanced English (written and verbal).
  • Previous experience as a Business Analyst or Systems Analyst .
  • Minimum of 3 years of experience with Azure DevOps .
  • Experience working on software development projects.
  • Strong understanding of application platforms and enterprise systems.
  • Ability to assess the impact of project requirements on integrated and external systems.
  • Experience working with server-based applications and understanding non-functional requirements.
  • Strong skills in business process analysis and documentation.
  • Experience creating and maintaining technical and functional documentation.
  • Advanced knowledge of Microsoft Word, Excel, and Outlook.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and project coordination skills.
  • Solid mathematical and logical reasoning capabilities.
  • Ability to work collaboratively with global and cross-functional teams.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working in Agile environments.
  • Knowledge of business process modeling methodologies.
  • Experience supporting international projects and distributed teams.
  • Familiarity with software testing methodologies and quality assurance processes.

What You Can Expect From Us

  • Continuous professional development aligned with your career goals.
  • Opportunities for international experience and exposure to global projects.
  • A collaborative, diverse, and innovative work environment.
  • Mentorship and career growth opportunities.

Benefits

  • Health Insurance
  • Dental Plan
  • Life Insurance
  • Transportation Allowance
  • Meal/Food Allowance
  • Childcare Assistance
  • TotalPass
  • 24/7 Employee Assistance Program (psychological, legal, and financial support)
  • Certification Reimbursement
  • Learning Platform with free training and courses
  • Employee Referral Bonus Program
  • Recognition Program
  • Mentorship and Career Development Platform

title: Survey & Insights Analyst
description:
Your Responsibilities:

The Survey & Insights Analyst supports Lockton's enterprise survey consultancy function, partnering with business units and geographies worldwide to design, deploy, and analyze surveys that create actionable insights. This role serves as a hands-on Qualtrics practitioner and analytical partner, helping internal teams translate research questions into survey programs and actionable findings while upholding data governance and privacy standards across regions.


Essential Duties:

  • Design, build, and program surveys in Qualtrics, including logic/branching, bilingual and multi-language routing, embedded data, and distribution workflows.
  • Serve as a subject matter resource for survey methodology, question design, and data quality across a portfolio of internal and client-facing survey programs.
  • Partner with stakeholders across regions and business units to scope survey requests, define objectives, and translate business questions into effective instrument design.
  • Clean, analyze, and synthesize survey data into reports, dashboards, and presentations for management and Associates.
  • Support data governance efforts, including PII/PHI risk review, survey inventory management, and adherence to global privacy requirements (e.g., GDPR, CCPA).
  • Provide consulting, training, and technical support to survey requestors throughout the survey lifecycle, from intake through post-deployment analysis.
  • Monitor project timelines and maintain responsibility for delivering accurate, on-time deliverables.
  • Communicate findings and recommendations clearly to both technical and non-technical, audiences.


Other Responsibilities:

  • Provides exceptional customer service and adheres to the Lockton philosophies
  • Collaborates cross-functionally with IT PMO, Digital Office, and People Solutions teams as needed


Qualifications

  • BS/BA degree required
  • 1+ years of experience in survey research, data analysis, market research, or a related analytical field
  • Demonstrated experience building and administering surveys in Qualtrics (or a comparable enterprise survey platform) required
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Excel required; experience with Power BI strongly preferred
  • Working knowledge of Python and SQL for data manipulation or automation preferred, but not required
  • Excellent written and spoken English proficiency required, given regular collaboration with international, multi-lingual stakeholders
  • Familiarity with survey methodology best practices, including question design and sampling.
  • Awareness of data privacy principles and regulations relevant to survey data (e.g., GDPR, CCPA) a plus
  • Ability to express complex technical concepts effectively, both verbally and in writing, to non-technical audiences
  • Demonstrated ability to analyze data from multiple sources and provide clear, actionable recommendations
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to manage multiple concurrent projects without sacrificing quality or accuracy
  • Comfortable working across time zones with globally distributed teams; some flexibility in working hours may be required

  • Apoiar decisões de engenharia de valor e gestão de riscos (obsolescência, lead time, compatibilidade, dependências de energia/dados, comissionamento e confiabilidade).

Testes, comissionamento e prontidão operacional

  • Estruturar, revisar e acompanhar a estratégia de testes e comissionamento: FAT/SAT, testes integrados (SIT), testes de aceitação, cenários de emergência, treinamento e handover.
  • Validar planos e evidências de desempenho dos sistemas, com rastreabilidade (requisitos → testes → resultados → pendências → aceite).
  • Apoiar a definição de requisitos de operação do CCO/CCM e rotinas de resposta a incidentes.


Sistemas no escopo (cobertura completa e integrada)

  • Free Flow + controle de tempo de percurso
  • Monitoramento 100% CFTV + sensoriamento de tráfego
  • Sensoriamento de tráfego com controle de velocidade
  • Rede de dados (fibra) com estações repetidoras
  • CCO
  • PMVs
  • Sinalização de emergência e abandono
  • Comunicação de emergência (megafonia e radiofonia)
  • Identificação automática de emergência
  • Combate a incêndio
  • Rádio
  • Iluminação
  • Ventilação
  • Eletrificação (AT/MT/BT, subestações, geradores, nobreak)
  • Cancela automática


Governança técnica, qualidade e conformidade (ARTESP/Contrato)

  • Conduzir revisões técnicas e validações independentes de especificações, projetos, memoriais, listas de interfaces, critérios de aceitação e planos de testes, garantindo rastreabilidade de decisões e atendimento aos ritos de aprovação.
  • Atuar como consultor, com liderança indireta sobre o time do projetista, construtora, integradores e fornecedores, garantindo consistência, completude e auditabilidade dos entregáveis.
  • Suportar tecnicamente temas de mudança e risco: alterações de escopo, não conformidades, engenharia de valor e subsídios técnicos para pleitos/claims (sem caráter jurídico).


Suporte à obra e entrega (As Built)

  • Acompanhar tecnicamente instalação, energização, integração e testes em campo, apoiando liberações, inspeções, tratamento de não conformidades e validação de desempenho.
  • Garantir o pacote As Built, com atualização de modelos/documentos, registros comparativos e evidências de conformidade dentro dos prazos definidos.


Requisitos


  • Experiência sólida com sistemas de infraestrutura crítica (túneis, rodovias, mobilidade, aeroportos, portos, utilidades), com atuação em elaboração de projetos, integração, comissionamento e/ou operação.
  • Capacidade de atuar como integrador/validador do lado do cliente, gerindo requisitos, interfaces e critérios de aceitação ao longo do ciclo completo.
  • Vivência com testes e comissionamento (FAT/SAT/SIT), documentação de evidências e gestão de pendências até aceite.
  • Conhecimento prático de arquitetura de sistemas (rede/telecom, energia, automação/sensoriamento, CCO) e integração entre subsistemas.
  • Inglês intermediário obrigatório; fluente desejável (interface com EPC/fornecedores internacionais).


Diferenciais


  • Experiência prévia em sistemas de túneis (ventilação, incêndio, emergência, CFTV, PMV, rádio, energia, automação e CCO).
  • Vivência com requisitos de disponibilidade, redundância, cibersegurança e integração via protocolos/arquiteturas (ex.: IEC, OPC, IP, NTP/PTP, SNMP, etc.).
  • Experiência em ambientes regulados e com forte governança de interfaces e aceitação.
  • Familiaridade com abordagem RAMS e requisitos de confiabilidade/segurança (quando aplicável).

description:

Atuando em estreita colaboração com as equipes de Marketing, Recursos Humanos e com as lideranças do Brasil, Argentina, Chile, Colômbia, México, Peru e Uruguai, o profissional será responsável por promover uma comunicação integrada, consistente e alinhada às necessidades de cada mercado, respeitando as particularidades culturais da região.


Além de liderar iniciativas de Comunicação Interna, a posição apoiará o desenvolvimento de propostas comerciais estratégicas (RFPs) e fornecerá suporte em design gráfico para clientes e prospects estratégicos, assegurando a consistência da marca, da comunicação e do posicionamento da Lockton em todos os pontos de contato.

Organizar documentação suporte e evidências.

title: Coordenador(a) de RAMS (Reliability, Availability, Maintainability & Safety)
description:
A Aldelia é uma multinacional franco-inglesa com foco em soluções de RH e terceirização de serviços.

Estamos Buscamos um(a) Coordenador(a) de RAMS (Reliability, Availability, Maintainability & Safety) para atuar em uma empresa referência em soluções para transporte ferroviário e energia, localizada na Zona Oeste de SP.

Buscamos profissionais para atuar em projetos ferroviários de grande porte, liderando as atividades relacionadas à Confiabilidade, Disponibilidade, Manutenibilidade e Segurança (RAMS) ao longo do ciclo de vida do projeto.

O profissional será responsável pela coordenação das entregas RAMS entre equipes de engenharia, fornecedores, consultores, avaliadores independentes de segurança (ISA) e stakeholders nacionais e internacionais, garantindo conformidade com os requisitos do projeto e com os padrões CENELEC.

A posição exige forte capacidade de coordenação técnica, gestão de interfaces e comunicação em inglês, devido à interação frequente com equipes globais e engenheiros chineses envolvidos no projeto.


Principais Responsabilidades:

Coordenação Técnica RAM

  • SPlanejar, coordenar e acompanhar todas as atividades RAMS do projeto
  • .Liderar a elaboração, atualização e implementação do Plano RAMS (RAMS Plan)
  • .Garantir a aplicação dos requisitos de RAMS ao longo das fases do projeto, conforme EN 50126
  • Coordenar as interfaces entre equipes de engenharia, integração de sistemas, operação, manutenção e fornecedores.


Gestão de Segurança e Riscos

  • Conduzir e participar de análises de risco e segurança, incluindo:

- PHA (Preliminary Hazard Analysis)

-IHA (Interface Hazard Analysis)

-HAZOP

-FTA (Fault Tree Analysis)

-FMEA/FMECA

-SIL Allocation e Verification

  • Liderar sessões de brainstorming técnico e workshops de análise de risco.
  • Manter e controlar o Hazard Log do projeto.


Gestão Documental e Compliance

  • Coordenar a preparação e revisão de toda a documentação RAMS, incluindo:

-RAMS Plan

-Hazard Log

-Safety Verification Plan

-Intermediate Safety Cases

-RAM Demonstration Plan

-SIL Allocation and Verification Reports

-Reliability Predictions

-Safety Assessments

  • Revisar documentos RAMS emitidos por fornecedores e subcontratados.
  • Garantir aderência aos requisitos normativos e contratuais.


Pré-requisitos:

Formação Acadêmica:

  • Formação superior em em Engenharia (Elétrica, Eletrônica, Controle e Automação, Mecânica, Produção ou áreas correlatas);
  • Inglês intermediário ou avançado para comunicação profissional;

Competências Técnicas:

  • Experiência em projetos ferroviários, metroviários ou de transporte de massa;

Modelo de trabalho:

  • Modelo 100% presencial na Zona Oeste – SP (segunda a sexta-feira), das 9h às 18h.

title: Supervisor fiscal
description:
Supervisor(a) Fiscal Tributário


Estamos em busca de um(a) Supervisor(a) Fiscal Tributário para atuar em uma empresa de grande porte, liderando as rotinas fiscais e tributárias e garantindo a conformidade com a legislação vigente.

Se você possui sólida experiência na área fiscal, perfil de liderança, visão analítica e busca um ambiente dinâmico e desafiador, essa oportunidade pode ser para você.

  • Revisar e validar notas fiscais, garantindo a correta apuração dos impostos a recolher e a recuperar.
  • Acompanhar as constantes alterações da legislação tributária e da Reforma Tributária, disseminando as atualizações para a equipe.
  • Coordenar e revisar o cumprimento das obrigações acessórias, assegurando conformidade e cumprimento dos prazos legais.

  • Liderar o desenvolvimento da equipe, promovendo capacitação técnica e melhoria contínua.
  • Estruturar processos, controles internos e procedimentos da área fiscal.
  • Identificar e corrigir gaps sistêmicos e cadastrais, contribuindo para a integração dos sistemas fiscais e ERP.
  • Participar de projetos relacionados à Reforma Tributária e implantação de novos controles e soluções fiscais.
  • Elaborar análises, relatórios gerenciais e propor melhorias para otimização dos processos.


Requisitos


  • Ensino Superior completo em Ciências Contábeis, Administração, Direito ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência consolidada na área Fiscal e Tributária.
  • Vivência em liderança e gestão de equipes.
  • Conhecimento aprofundado da legislação tributária federal, estadual e municipal.
  • Experiência com apuração de impostos, obrigações acessórias e atendimento à fiscalização.
  • Conhecimento em ERP e ferramentas de gestão fiscal.
  • Perfil analítico, organizado e com foco em melhoria de processos.


Será considerado um diferencial


  • Pós-graduação ou especialização em Tributação, Contabilidade Tributária ou áreas correlatas.
  • Participação em projetos relacionados à Reforma Tributária.
  • Experiência em implantação de processos, controles fiscais e integração de sistemas.
  • Vivência em empresas de médio ou grande porte.


Perfil desejado


Buscamos um(a) profissional com perfil de liderança, excelente capacidade analítica, visão sistêmica, senso de urgência, organização e habilidade para atuar em um ambiente de constante atualização da legislação tributária, contribuindo para a evolução dos processos e o desenvolvimento da equipe.

title: Human Resources Manager(Mandarin preferred)
description:
The ideal candidate will support the full scope of Human Resources responsibilities and partner with the organization on strategic initiatives. They will maintain and enhance the organization's human resources by planning, implementing, and evaluating human resources policies, programs, and practices.


Responsibilities

  1. Develop and implement the HR strategic plan for the Latin America region, and regularly prepare HR status analysis reports.
  2. Oversee recruitment for job vacancies in the Latin America region, and participate in the annual and periodic centralized recruitment organized by headquarters.
  3. Optimize the employee performance indicator system in the Latin America region, and organize and implement performance appraisals and incentive programs.
  4. Establish a local compensation system for the Latin America region, communicate and enforce compensation policies, review employee payroll, and conduct monthly headcount and labor cost statistics.
  5. In accordance with headquarters' HR management policies, build a promotion and dismissal mechanism for employees in the Latin America region, handle daily management matters, and report to headquarters for approval.
  6. Develop localized training plans for the Latin America region and organize the implementation of relevant training programs.
  7. Manage the local HR team and provide professional support and guidance for the team's daily work.
  8. Prepare the annual headcount plan, labor cost budget, and fixed asset budget.
  9. Supervise and manage the localized administrative operations in the Latin America region.
  10. Complete other ad-hoc tasks assigned by leadership.


Qualifications

  1. Education: Bachelor's degree or above in HR or related management fields.
  2. Experience: 3+ years of HR management experience in Latin America.
  3. Knowledge: General business management; HR management; Latin American labor market and regulations.
  4. Skills: Proficient in writing, negotiation, and MS Office.
  5. Competencies: Strong planning, organization, coordination, analysis, communication, and interpersonal skills; excellent cross-cultural and team collaboration abilities.
  6. Special Requirements: English as working language; prior HR experience in Latin America.
  7. Preferred: Chinese language skills are a plus.


岗位简介

全面负责人力资源全模块管理工作，作为业务伙伴深度协同各部门，推动战略性人力举措落地。通过规划、执行与优化人力资源政策及项目，持续提升组织效能与人才管理水平

岗位职责

  1. 制定并实施拉美区域人力资源战略规划，定期撰写人力资源状况分析报告。
  2. 负责拉美区域岗位空缺的招聘工作，并参与总部组织的年度及阶段性统一招聘。
  3. 优化拉美区域员工绩效指标体系，组织并实施绩效考核与激励方案。
  4. 制定拉美区域属地薪酬制度，宣贯执行薪酬制度，审核员工工资，月度人员信息及人工成本统计。
  5. 依据总部人力资源管理制度，构建拉美区域员工晋升与淘汰机制，负责日常管理并报总部审批。
  6. 制定拉美区域属地化培训计划，并组织实施相关培训项目。
  7. 管理当地人力资源团队，为团队日常工作提供专业支持与指导。
  8. 负责年度人员编制、人工成本预算及固定资产预算的编制工作。
  9. 监督并管理拉美区域属地化行政工作的开展。
  10. 完成领导临时交办的工作。

任职要求

  • 教育背景 ：本科及以上学历，人力资源或相关管理类专业。
  • 工作经验 ：3年及以上拉美区域人力资源管理工作经验。
  • 知识要求 ：了解基本企业管理知识，熟悉人力资源管理知识，熟悉拉美地区人力资源市场动态及相关劳动政策法规。
  • 基本技能 ：具备一定的写作能力、谈判能力，能够熟练操作计算机办公软件。
  • 核心能力 ：具有较强的计划、组织、协调、分析、沟通、人际交往、语言和文字表达能力。具备出色的跨文化沟通能力及团队协作精神。
  • 特殊要求 ：英语可作为工作语言，有拉美地区人力资源从业经验。
  • 优先条件 ：具备中文语言能力者优先考虑。
